item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Nidhi's magnetic compass resting flat on a wooden desk, away from other magnets. After the needle settles, she notes which tip points toward geographic north.

What has the settled needle helped her find?

options.A: North–south direction; the tip toward geographic north is the North-seeking pole.
options.B: North–south direction while the needle is still swinging.
options.C: A direction that a plain iron pin on the desk would show the same way.
options.D: East–west direction, because the red paint on that tip marks east.
